name: 876cd9da93f2
claim: Queued outbox items deliver once the peer TLS front end becomes reachable: --remap-peer-ip overrides the stale stored peer address, --remap-port 8002:8443 maps the plain portal port onto TLS, and a drop counts as delivered only with ok true, received_at and a matching byte count; the drained queue then shows zero queued rows.

decisions.notes: First flush after the peer TLS endpoint came up on 8443 delivered every queued item; a verification flush then reported delivered 0, still queued 0 and outbox-status showed zero queued rows.

rationale: Delivery gate is reachability of the peer TLS endpoint plus correct remap flags; success is verified from ok true, received_at and byte counts, not from absence of errors.
